matches.rationale: The ground truth is a broad claim that Theorem 5.1's proof contains a logical flaw/gap, later corrected in an erratum. Several findings (7, 8, 9, 10, 11) independently identify concrete logical breakdowns within the Section 5 proof of this main isogeny-invariance theorem (undefined/trivial Galois group claims, unjustified finiteness assumptions for Euler characteristics, an inverted formula in equation (11), inconsistent use of Corollary 2.17, and a flawed kernel-of-isogeny claim in Remark 5.2), each surfacing a symptom of the same underlying proof-logic defect.
